stories.story_fr: L'ARR combine Agentforce et Data 360 atteint pres de 3,4 Md$ au T1 FY27, avec l'ARR Agentforce seul en hausse de 205% sur un an : la monetisation de l'IA agentique passe a l'echelle.
stories.story_en: Combined Agentforce and Data 360 ARR reaches nearly $3.4B in Q1 FY27, with Agentforce ARR alone up 205% year-over-year: agentic AI monetization is scaling.
stories.quote: Agentforce and Data 360 annual recurring revenue (ARR) reaches nearly $3.4 billion... Agentforce ARR, up 205% Y/Y

stories.story_fr: Salesforce a delivre 3,8 milliards d'Agentic Work Units a ses clients (+111% sequentiel), une nouvelle metrique mesurant le travail reel accompli par les agents IA sur Agentforce et Slack.
stories.story_en: Salesforce delivered 3.8 billion Agentic Work Units for customers (+111% Q/Q), a new metric measuring real work accomplished by AI agents across Agentforce and Slack.
stories.quote: 3.8 billion Agentic Work Units (AWUs) delivered to date across Agentforce and Slack, growing 111% quarter-over-quarter

stories.story_fr: Au T4 FY26, les obligations de performance restantes depassent 72 Md$ (+14% sur un an) et le cRPO bondit de 16%, signe d'une demande contractee solide et en acceleration.
stories.story_en: In Q4 FY26 total remaining performance obligation exceeds $72B (+14% Y/Y) and cRPO jumps 16%, a sign of solid and accelerating contracted demand.
stories.quote: RPO Exceeds $72B, Up 14% Y/Y; ... Current remaining performance obligation of $35.1 billion, up 16%

stories.story_fr: Salesforce a signe plus de 29 000 contrats Agentforce depuis le lancement (+50% sequentiel), avec un ARR Agentforce a 800 M$ en hausse de 169% sur un an.
stories.story_en: Salesforce closed over 29,000 Agentforce deals since launch (+50% Q/Q), with Agentforce ARR at $800M up 169% year-over-year.
stories.quote: Agentforce ARR reached $800 million, up 169% year-over-year, and we've closed 29,000 deals, up 50% quarter-over-quarter

stories.story_fr: Data 360 a ingere 52 000 milliards d'enregistrements au T1 FY27 (+136% sur un an), dont 35 000 milliards via Zero Copy (+277%), socle de donnees alimentant les agents IA.
stories.story_en: Data 360 ingested 52 trillion records in Q1 FY27 (+136% Y/Y), including 35 trillion via Zero Copy (+277%), the data foundation powering AI agents.
stories.quote: Data 360 ingested 52 trillion records, up 136% Y/Y, including 35 trillion via Zero Copy, up 277% Y/Y
